newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume up.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange prices rallied with world markets on Thursday to close at $343.50 an ounce and 1,324,900 lira per gram, up from Wednesday's $338.00 and 1,301,000, dealers said.
"There wasn't much physical demand from the market due to the increasing prices, what trade there was mostly arbitrage deals by the banks," one dealer said.
Volume rose to 855 kilos from 683 on Wednesday.
The Turkish lira fell slightly on Thursday to 119,750 to the dollar from 119,725 on Wednesday's close.
The bulk of the day's trade -- 630 kilos -- was in the morning.
Some 66.7 percent of trade was in lira terms.
